overview: Sanctus Seru is the authoritarian stronghold of the Seru loyalists.
history: Founded after the schism with Katta Castellum.
Built as a fortress‑city emphasizing discipline and military might.
Administratum governs all aspects of life with strict oversight.
The Citadel houses Seru’s elite guard and political leadership.
hooks: A Justicar declares a citywide lockdown.
Arcane surveillance nodes detect unusual magical activity.
A political envoy from Katta is detained at the gate.
The Citadel issues a decree affecting all travelers.
